properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-family hash libraries declared in the lockfile (e.g. @chainsafe/as-sha256, js-sha3/sha3, hasha) — transitive hash dependencies of the Ethereum/web3 toolchain that the build ships. Dependency inventory; changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA capability declared via node-forge@1.3.1 (RSA keygen/sign/encrypt) in the lockfile. Pulled by selfsigned ← webpack-dev-server — dev tooling for local HTTPS dev certificates, not shipped runtime crypto. Changeable by upgrading dev tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature capability declared via tweetnacl (nacl.sign) and node-forge — dependencies of @metamask/eth-sig-util / sshpk / selfsigned chains. No direct call site in repo code. Shor-vulnerable signature; migration to ML-DSA; changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA capability declared via elliptic@6.5.4 and @noble/secp256k1 (secp256k1 ECDSA sign/recover) — the crypto behind truffle's live signing chains: hdwallet-provider signs EIP-712 typed data through @metamask/eth-sig-util and transactions through @ethereumjs/tx (both reported as live findings). Shor-vulnerable signature scheme; changeable here only with an ecosystem-wide PQ signature migration (ECDSA/secp256k1 is fixed by the Ethereum protocol).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH (Curve25519 scalar multiplication, nacl.box) capability declared via tweetnacl@1.0.3 (dependency of @metamask/eth-sig-util, the hdwallet-provider signer) and tweetnacl@0.14.5 (sshpk/http-signature chain). No direct call site in the repo's own code — the provider calls only signTypedData. Shor-vulnerable if used; declared capability, changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519/Curve25519 key-exchange capability declared via tweetnacl (nacl.box) — dependency of @metamask/eth-sig-util and sshpk chains. No direct call site in repo code. Shor-vulnerable agreement if exercised; changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES capability declared via aes-js@3.x, browserify-aes and node-forge in the lockfile — browserified crypto polyfills for the webpack browser bundles and the web3 keystore encryption stack (AES-CTR in V3 keystores). No direct call site in truffle's own code. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 capability declared in the lockfile: browserify pbkdf2@^3 (webpack crypto polyfill for browser bundles) and bcrypt-pbkdf (sshpk chain). Note the LIVE PBKDF2 use in truffle's own code is BIP39 seed derivation (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations) via ethereum-cryptography/bip39 in hdwallet-provider and core — reported separately. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 capability declared via @chainsafe/as-sha256 in the lockfile — transitive dependency of the Ethereum toolchain; shipped in the build. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE-family hash capability declared via blakejs@1.1.0 (BLAKE2b implementation) — transitive dependency of @ensdomains/address-encoder (ENS multi-chain address encoding). No direct call site in truffle's own code. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/Keccak capability declared via sha3@2.1.1 and js-sha3@0.5.7/0.8.0 — the keccak256 implementation inside web3-utils, which truffle's own code invokes live as soliditySha3()/sha3() across abi-utils, codec, db, debugger, resolver and source-map-utils (reported as live findings). Protocol-fixed hash; Grover-only exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (tweetnacl secretbox/box) capability declared in the lockfile — tweetnacl@1.0.3 via @metamask/eth-sig-util (hdwallet-provider's signer) and tweetnacl@0.14.5 via sshpk. No direct call site in repo code (only signTypedData is called). Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 self-signed certificate generation capability declared via selfsigned@2.1.1 — dependency of webpack-dev-server (dev tooling that serves local HTTPS with a self-signed node-forge certificate). Dev-time only, not shipped runtime crypto; changeable by upgrading dev tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 certificate machinery declared via node-forge@1.3.1 — pulled by selfsigned/webpack-dev-server for dev HTTPS certificates. Dev tooling only; changeable by upgrading dev tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl declared in the lockfile at two versions: 1.0.3 (via @metamask/eth-sig-util — hdwallet-provider's typed-data signer) and 0.14.5 (via sshpk/http-signature, and bcrypt-pbkdf). Provides Ed25519/X25519/XSalsa20-Poly1305 capability; truffle's own code calls only eth-sig-util's signTypedData. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@2.0.4/3.0.1 declared in the lockfile — the scrypt KDF used by web3's V3-keystore passphrase derivation in the Ethereum toolchain. No direct call site in truffle's own code; keystore KDF capability shipped in the build. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js declared in the lockfile — SHA-1/SHA-256 stream implementations in the browserify crypto polyfill chain used by truffle's webpack browser bundles (dashboard). Capability shipped in the build; no direct call site in repo code. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 declared in the lockfile — ECDSA/ECDH on secp256k1/P-256 etc. used by the ethereumjs/browserify stack (ABI decoding, transaction utilities). The live secp256k1 signing in truffle's own code runs through @ethereumjs/tx and @metamask/eth-sig-util (reported as live findings). Changeable by dependency upgrade; Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.1.2 declared in the lockfile — the hash/KDF library inside ethereum-cryptography that truffle's own code uses LIVE: keccak256 for Ethereum address derivation (@truffle/hdwallet index.ts:1) and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (2048 iterations) for BIP39 seed derivation in hdwallet-provider and core. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: selfsigned@2.1.1 declared in the lockfile — generates self-signed certificates (via node-forge RSA/X.509) for webpack-dev-server local HTTPS in development. Dev tooling only; changeable by upgrading dev tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js declared in the lockfile — hash implementations (SHA, RIPEMD160) in the elliptic/browserify chain. Capability shipped in the build; no direct call site in repo code. Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@^3 declared in the lockfile — browserify PBKDF2 polyfill used by the webpack crypto shims for browser bundles. Capability shipped in the build; truffle's live BIP39 PBKDF2 runs in @noble/hashes instead (reported as live findings). Changeable by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@1.3.1 declared in the lockfile — TLS/X.509/RSA/PKCS machinery pulled via selfsigned/webpack-dev-server for development HTTPS certificates. Dev tooling only; changeable by upgrading dev tooling.
